data:text/html,<body><canvas id=""c"></canvas><style>body{margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:%23111;touch-action:none}</style><script> const ctx = c.getContext("2d"); const KEYS = "dfjk"; const COLORS = ["%23f55", "%23fa3", "%235d5", "%2358f"]; const BPM = 120; const STEP = 60 / BPM / 2; const FALL_TIME = 1.5; const PERFECT = 0.05, GOOD = 0.15; const PATTERN = "0.1.2.3.0.1.23..3.2.1.0.0.12.3.0.1.2.3.03.1.2.1.0."; let audio, songStart, nextBeat, endTime; let notes = [], score = 0, combo = 0, message = ""; let started = false; function reset() { notes = []; for (let i = 0; i < PATTERN.length * 3; i++) { const ch = PATTERN[i %25 PATTERN.length]; if (ch != ".") notes.push({ lane: +ch, time: 2 + i * STEP, state: 0 }); } endTime = 2 + PATTERN.length * 3 * STEP + 1; score = combo = nextBeat = 0; message = ""; songStart = performance.now() / 1000; started = true; } const laneWidth = () => Math.min(c.width / 4, 100); const laneLeft = () => (c.width - laneWidth() * 4) / 2; const hitY = () => c.height * 0.85; function beep(freq, length, volume) { const osc = audio.createOscillator(); const gain = audio.createGain(); osc.frequency.value = freq; gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, audio.currentTime); gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audio.currentTime + length); osc.connect(gain); gain.connect(audio.destination); osc.start(); osc.stop(audio.currentTime + length); } function hit(lane) { if (!started || performance.now() / 1000 - songStart > endTime) { audio = audio || new AudioContext(); reset(); return; } const t = performance.now() / 1000 - songStart; let best = null; for (const n of notes) { if (n.lane == lane && n.state == 0 && Math.abs(n.time - t) < GOOD) { if (!best || Math.abs(n.time - t) < Math.abs(best.time - t)) best = n; } } onkeydown = (e) => { if (e.repeat) return; const lane = KEYS.indexOf(e.key.toLowerCase()); if (lane >= 0 || !started) hit(Math.max(lane, 0)); }; onpointerdown = (e) => { hit(Math.floor((e.clientX - laneLeft()) / laneWidth())); }; function update(t) { while (nextBeat * 2 * STEP <= t) { beep(nextBeat %25 4 ? 90 : 60, 0.1, 0.4); nextBeat++; } for (const n of notes) { if (n.state == 0 && t - n.time > GOOD) { n.state = 2; combo = 0; message = "MISS"; } } } function draw(t) { ctx.fillStyle = "%23111"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height); const w = laneWidth(), left = laneLeft(), y = hitY(); // lanes, hit line and key labels ctx.font = "20px monospace"; ctx.textAlign = "center"; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { ctx.fillStyle = i %25 2 ? "%23181818" : "%231e1e1e"; ctx.fillRect(left + i * w, 0, w, c.height); ctx.fillStyle = COLORS[i]; ctx.fillRect(left + i * w + 4, y, w - 8, 4); ctx.fillText(KEYS[i].toUpperCase(), left + i * w + w / 2, y + 30); } for (const n of notes) { if (n.state) continue; const ny = y * (1 - (n.time - t) / FALL_TIME); if (ny < -20 || ny > c.height) continue; ctx.fillStyle = COLORS[n.lane]; ctx.fillRect(left + n.lane * w + 8, ny - 10, w - 16, 20); } ctx.fillStyle = "white"; ctx.fillText("Score " + score, c.width / 2, 30); if (combo > 1) ctx.fillText(combo + " combo", c.width / 2, 60); ctx.fillText(message, c.width / 2, y - 40); if (!started) ctx.fillText("Press D F J K or tap lanes to start", c.width / 2, c.height / 2); if (started && t > endTime) ctx.fillText("Done! Tap to play again", c.width / 2, c.height / 2); }
